reviews.text:
I can’t say enough good things about GoPet. My Pomeranian had a very serious, painful wound from a dog bite, and I went to six different places before finding GoPet. They all quoted me thousands of dollars. GoPet was a godsend.

They used light therapy, and my Pomeranian’s deep wound has healed remarkably well in such a short time. Every staff member has been incredibly kind. I’m so grateful to have finally found an affordable, amazing vet for my fur babies. I’ll be bringing all my pets here, and I recommend GoPet wholeheartedly. I can’t thank them enough!

It was my first time visiting and my experience was very good. They helped my cat right away and prescribed the medicine she needed. The doctor is amazing, patient, and explains everything well. The receptionist was also very nice.
Dr. Eric provides top-notch care and treats every pet like family. His staff is equally amazing, making every visit a great experience. Thank you!

Dr. Eric and his team are just amazing!! I couldn’t be more grateful for the care, kindness, and professionalism they showed while treating my beloved one. From the moment we arrived, we felt welcomed and in great hands.

A special thank you to Gina, who provides top-notch service and goes above and beyond to make both pets and owners feel comfortable.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for compassionate and reliable care.

We have 5 dogs and 2 cats that are patients of doctor Eric so I can’t recommend him enough! My frencie is old and sick often so we visit the clinic at least twice a month just for him, and I come in so stressed every time and doctor Eric has this amazing care and energy that clams me and helps me to get my dogs back on track. He cares so much for each animal and he loves them like his own on top of being professional and that’s hard to find 🙏🏼
The best.  Eric and crew.  Thank you.

Dr. Gutierrez, I've been coming here with my pets for years, and unfortunately, your new staff is nothing like you and the care you used to provide. I'm very worried because there's no longer a trustworthy veterinarian in the neighborhood.
Excellent service!!! Very warm and professional

Gina's care was excellent—kind, helpful, and attentive.
Dr. Gutiérrez is a wonderful person who treats your dog with love and provides the best service, always willing to work toward their improvement and health. Thank you, and blessings to his team.
Dr. Erick Gutierrez is an excellent professional and a wonderful person. He and his entire team do the best work for the well-being of my pets and provide excellent customer service. 👍👍👍 …
The staff is excellent and welcoming, the doctor is fantastic! Highly recommend coming here!

I took both of my Frenchies in, and Dr. Eric was amazing! He was very professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring with both of them. He took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure we felt comfortable throughout the visit. You can tell he truly cares about the animals he treats. I’m extremely happy with the experience and would definitely recommend Dr. Eric to anyone looking for a great veterinarian. Thank you for taking such great care of my Frenchies!

Always a great experience at GOPET Hospital. The entire team is friendly, attentive, and genuinely caring. Gina, Anabel, Brenda, Hilario, and Nino are always wonderful, and Dr. Gutierrez is excellent at what he does, you can really see how much he cares by the way he treats the animals. Highly recommend!
I love the staff and Dr Eric Guiterrez

After taking my dog to **three different veterinary clinics**, where I spent a lot of money and, unfortunately, no one was able to correctly diagnose what was wrong with him, I finally found **GoPet**\.

From the very first day, the GoPet team correctly diagnosed my dog with **pancreatitis** and prescribed the appropriate treatment and medication\. The difference in the quality of care was incredible\.

The treatment we received was **exceptional, professional, and, above all, compassionate**\. You can tell that they genuinely care about the animals and their families\.

From now on, **GoPet will be my dogs’ veterinary clinic**\.

Thank you so much to the entire GoPet team for helping my dog and saving my pet\. ❤️🐾

Best experience! Dr Gutiérrez and his staff are very profesional , honest and compassive persons!
I recomend 100% to come there !!
Very convenience and reasonable prices and attention

I’ve heard people say, “the doctor is good.” Based on my experience, I completely disagree.

More importantly, even if the doctor were excellent, your pet is also handled by the staff the same staff responsible for answering phones, managing records, and responding to urgent situations.

My dog vomited nine times. Despite being an existing patient, there was no sense of urgency. Staff couldn’t even locate my dog’s information while I was trying to get help. Watching a pet become seriously ill is stressful enough without having to deal with disorganization and delays.

The best word I can use to describe my experience is incompetence.

If you love your pet and expect timely, attentive care, I would strongly recommend taking them elsewhere.

When your pet is sick, you need a team that is organized, responsive, and compassionate. Unfortunately, that was not my experience at GoPet Hospital.

Updated Review: 08.25.2026

I wanted to provide a quick update following my previous experience with GoPet Hospital.

After I requested my dog’s rabies vaccination records, since he will be going to a new veterinarian. Brenda contacted me directly for the first time. During that conversation, I was told that the records would be provided if I could remove my review. I respectfully declined, because I believe customers should be able to share their honest experiences.

Brenda then said the vaccination information would still be sent to me. Unfortunately, it was not, so I ultimately had to follow up by email to request the information again.

My intention is not to be disrespectful or unfair to anyone. I simply believe that communication, transparency, and providing clients with their pets’ medical records should not depend on whether a review is removed.

I’m sharing this update so others can make informed decisions based on the full experience not just the outcome, but also how concerns are handled when they arise.

My parents have taken my pet there for the past few years and I can’t not express the appreciation for the staff and the doctors my parents have taken him for years the moment I walked in to the moment I walked out was great service. I will definitely keep going to go pet !
Thanks Daniela for taking the time and giving as the opportunity to help you!

Loved the location !!! Very clean and sweet. They took care of not only my pet, but me as well. They reassured me every step of the process that I was well informed of my pets status and wellbeing. The doctor and the staff were amazing. Recomment them all the way.

The best!! Absolutely perfect!! Highly recommended 💯 You'll feel like family!! Professionalism and attention!! My second time here and I'm already part of this wonderful family!! Blessings!! Thank you for taking care of these adopted children who bring us back to life!!

My pet bally had congested heart, I gave him his meds every day and every night. Bally was my first real pet, he helped me gain perspective in life. We brought him to go pet after seeing him have a cough that wouldn't go away. Anyways after receiving the meds for 3 years we brought him in for bloodwork and to refill his meds. The Dr said he he would give him 2 shots and do the blood work... We'll a week later we was bringing our pet back in n and this time it was to say goodbye... You see the Dr blown out his kidneys and basically killed my pet... Don't know why he double dosed him without reading his chart... To make it even worse is the 2 shots he gave him never went in his chart. Don't know why he still has a license to do veterinary work because of it was a person.... Can we say malpractice...for 5 months to the day I've been crying every day and play the situation over and over in my head. If you love your pet pls get a 2nd opinion.. He will never get another chance to hurt any other pet I have. You should be ashamed...

I only trust Dr. Eric and Brenda at Go Pet Animal Hospital with my pets. There is truly nowhere else I would ever bring them. They are the most honest, compassionate, and dedicated veterinary team in all of South Florida. Every visit feels like my pets are treated as family, not just patients. If you want a vet who actually cares, this is the place.

This is truly an exceptional veterinary practice. Dr. Eric stands out for his outstanding knowledge, the accuracy of his diagnoses, and especially for the incredibly caring way he treats both the dogs and their owners. He always explains everything with great clarity, patience, and dedication.

His entire team is highly trained and genuinely caring toward both the animals and their families. From the office manager to everyone at the front desk, they are always warm, kind, attentive, and ready to help.

You can truly see that everyone works together as a coordinated team, which gives you an incredible sense of trust and peace of mind.

I would not take my dogs to any other veterinarian in Miami. I recommend Dr. Eric and his entire team without hesitation.

I’ve been bringing my two dogs to GoPet Hospital for many years, and I couldn’t recommend them more. Brenda and Mino are always so kind and caring, and Dr. Eric is incredibly knowledgeable, and takes the time to explain everything.

The entire team treats my dogs as if they were their own, which gives me complete peace of mind every time we visit. Thank you for taking such amazing care of them over the years and 100% recommend.

My cat needed a surgery and I had to involve non profits. It was not an easy process, for me or for the GOPET office. Brenda was the person (receptionist or possibly part of the medical team?) who helped me so tremendously, absolutely instrumental. She was so kind and patient, and encouraging during such a difficult time.
I have loved Dr. Gutierrez ever since he helped my older cat and got to the root of her issues (4 other vets failed to diagnose and solve her issues). I’ve already left a review here for that on my main account. But I need to leave a review after the experience I just had with Brenda too-
this being my first interaction with her, and thank God. Her help and patience is what reminds me of why it’s so important to find the right vet office for your cats. With a staff you can trust, who reflect the values and effort I’ve already experienced with Dr. Gutierrez. I should also note that I called several offices just to see if there were ones that would be more cost effective, and there were not… Which did surprise me because there are so many chain vets now. Though I was relieved because I wanted to stay with the vet I have known now for 5 years.
Also the receptionist Jen was so so sweet and helpful and supportive to this operation as well. Just a ray of sunshine in Jen and a warrior in Brenda.
Thank you so much.
- Mango’s mom, Jillian
Some GoPet highlights
-I had a rescue Kitten with severe neck injury. Temporarily paralyzed for a week. The staff was absolutely incredible. The vet was beyond gentle beyond wonderful. They were extremely extremely forgiving with the cost for this particular visit. She made a full recovery. No upcharging at all- only discounting, at time when anyone else would have.
- Five years ago, I brought my old cat in after 4+ vets told me it was normal that she threw up every single meal and would eat your dinner off your plate like she was starving. Dr. Gutierrez diagnosed her and she has been perfect ever since.
- Now this Experience with the grants and my middle cat Mango.

I don’t think 1000 stars would be enough

Professional all around. Top notch place , service, Doctors.  Staff very helpful and they all care about your baby.  Minus 1 star: I had to call re test results or follow up visits. But not a deal breaker.

Guys! I cannot express how much I adore this place. Dr. Gutierrez not only loves animals but is also knowledgeable and resourceful. He has helped me with so many different animals and I truly would not trust anyone else. Bring your pets, you won’t regret it!

I have been coming to Dr.Eric for a long time now and each time I have never been disappointed. He and his staff listens to every concern, question and gives us the best advice to help my fur babies and I.

Dr. Gutierrez is an absolute genius of a veterinarian and a gem of a human being. I first brought my dog to him that had been hit by a car when I found him on the side of the road. He broke his leg and then walked on it, which made the bones overlap and over time fused together. One vet wanted to cut both bones and he would have a shorter leg for the rest of his life. Dr. Gutierrez said no we are going to unfuse the bone, separate it and put it together the right way and wire it. My dog would have had a shorter leg which would have led to major hip problems later in life. Thank you, GoPet for not only taking care of my babies, but doing a better job the right way.

Highly accurate on their diagnosis,treatment and outcome of my beloved pet.I live in Plantation but I feel so confident to take my pets here even if I  have to deal with the heavy traffic cuz is definitely worthy!!
I came back today 3 years later and the outstanding service is still going on.
Dr.Erik Gutierrez gives his best as well as Gina and Brenda,the front desk ladies who complement the great treatment given to my dogs.!
Excellent service

Dr. Gutierrez knowledge, professionalism, and compassion is evident from the first visit and every visit after. He takes his time, throughly explains things, answers all your questions. He’s a solid diagnostician. As a cat owner it can be a challenge to find a vet who’s good with cats, most being more comfortable dogs. Dr. G is so patient with my cats.

A few months ago I might have subtracted one star (at the most) due to some attitude issues with staff. Not anymore. I’m very impressed with the improvement.

Dr. Eric Gutierrez and hi's staff are very kind and professional... I went with my dog fir control and vaccination and some skin allergy and Doc Eric give me new instructions for her and my dog doesn't have anymore skin allergy and she return to correct weight... Thank you very much Doctor i recomend this clinic 100% picture before and after

If you’re looking for a vet, GoPet is truly the place, without a doubt!!!!

Our Frenchie has been coming here since he was a puppy, and now, at 4 years old, we honestly can’t imagine going anywhere else. From the very beginning, they have taken such incredible care of him and of us too. They have been there through every stage of his life, always with patience, compassion and genuine concern.

Dr. Eric is just incredible. Not only is he an outstanding professional, but he is also one of the kindest, most genuine people we have ever met. Our Frenchie has gone through some really scary health situations over the years, and Dr. Eric has literally saved his life more than once. I don’t say that lightly. He is always been there for us, explaining everything, calming us down and treating our baby with so much love and care, like he is his own.

And it’s not just Dr. Eric, the entire GoPet team deserves recognition. Every single visit, we are welcomed with warmth and kindness. The front desk staff is always friendly, organized and helpful. The technicians are incredibly gentle, attentive and compassionate. You can genuinely feel that everyone there deeply cares about every animal that walks through the door.

We are beyond grateful to Dr. Eric and the whole GoPet team for everything they have done for our Frenchie and for us. Their dedication, professionalism and heart make such a difference. If you’re looking for a place where your pet will be treated like family, I can’t recommend GoPet enough. ❤️🐶❤️

This is my second dog I have taken to GOPET.  I had a senior dog several years ago that needed special care and Dr Guitierez was wonderful.  My other dog is a Chow Chow that as he gets older gets more stubborn so its not so easy to get blood or to cut his nails.  I recently dropped him off for a full list of procedures:  anal gland draining, nail trim, teeth cleaning, blood test, and ears cleaned.  GOPET did a wonderful job and my dog Tony is doing great and has the whitest teeth ever.  The price was so reasonable and would have been so much more at other vets.  Dr Guitierez really knows his stuff especially when it comes to senior dogs and stubborn breeds.
Thank you to GoPet for the quality and warmth of their care, and to Brenda, Gina, Nino, and Dr. Gutierrez!

Dr. Eric is truly an extraordinary veterinarian. He doesn’t just do his job, he does it with all his heart. Sometimes I think that in another life he must have been a dog, a cat, or another animal because he has such an incredible ability to understand them. He treats every pet as if it were his own, with genuine love, patience, and compassion.

What makes him even more special is the way he cares for people, too. He is always kind, compassionate, and available for his clients, making every visit a positive experience.

His entire team reflects the same values. Everyone is welcoming, professional, knowledgeable, and truly dedicated to providing the best care possible. You can feel that they genuinely love what they do, and it shows in every interaction.

I have five animals, three dogs and two cats, and every single one of them loves Dr. Eric. Knowing they are in his care gives me complete peace of mind. I trust him wholeheartedly, and I couldn’t recommend him and his amazing team more highly.
Gino loves Dr Eric & all the staff at GoPet Hospital. They are the Best
Office is amazing. It’s always clean and well staffed. Staff is great, very knowledgeable and friendly. Dr Gutierrez is the best. Would highly recommend this office.
Dr Gutierrez and Dr Castillo are amazing.  The staff is always friendly and super helpful.

Dr. Eric and his associates are wonderful people with our furry children.
The doctor is very precise in his diagnoses; I treated Elvis there and now I treat Mia.
My daughters bring their pets and are very grateful.

We get everything done here just perfectly. Professionally. Good vibes, tone of love and attention to my pet. Definitely not going to anywhere from now. If we need the vet again we go ONLY here. Thank you team!

If I could give GoPet Hospital 100 stars, I would.

Dr. Gutierrez and his entire staff have become like family throughout our journey. Their compassion, kindness, and genuine love for animals are unlike anything I've experienced.

When Mia was diagnosed with tumors, every specialist we saw gave us the same heartbreaking options: chemotherapy, amputation, or nothing at all. Then we found Dr. Gutierrez. He refused to give up on her. Through his expertise, determination, and incredible care, he gave Mia at least two more amazing years of life—years filled with memories that I will cherish forever.

Those extra years meant everything to me. They gave me more walks, more adventures, more cuddles, and more time with my best friend. I truly don't know what our lives would have looked like without Dr. Gutierrez and his incredible team.

Thank you for treating Mia like she was your own and for giving us a gift that can never be repaid. You will always have a special place in our hearts, and I will forever recommend GoPet Hospital to anyone looking for veterinarians who genuinely care.
I have been bringing my pets here for nearly four years. Never again.
Excellent customer service, thank you for your love for pets
Gina and Brenda are the ultimate dream team!! They show their love and care for the fur babies AND their humans!

The best attention, 100% recomended.
Excellent service, best, Doctor, best prices, best front desk, quality service 🤩 …

I took my pet here and it was great. The staff was phenomenal from the front desk to the back! Everything was very well organized, sanitary, and communication was clear. I understood every step of my pets treatment and it was very easy to organize an appointment so my pet can be properly evaluated by Dr. and staff! They made me understand that rechecks are very important to make sure medications and working properly and my pet is feeling better! Cannot recommend it more, the wait is worth it!

Dr. Gutierrez has been my dogs' vet for quite a few years. As a doctor and a professional, he is the best. The customer service is excellent. I recommend Gopet Hospital to anyone who has a pet, dog or cat, and wants to receive the best treatment and care.

I've brought my dogs to Gopet Hospital for several years. Dr. Gutierrez and his assistants in the various departments are all professional and very kind. They all offer the best service to our pets, and Dr. Gutierrez, as a doctor, is exceptional—intelligent, kind, and a true lover of our furry friends.

GOpet has been my family’s veterinarian for years. You will never find another like Dr.Gutierrez and his staff. From the front desk to the assistants, they all make you feel like family and they genuinely care. We have frenchies and as everyone knows they are prone to all kinds of maladies. My moms
Boy has epilepsy, my girl allergies to everything under the sun, ear infections and the common back strains due to her crazy active nature. They have helped us in every way imaginable and we couldn’t be more thankful for their care and amazing attentiveness. If you love your pets bring them here. I live in Hialeah and my mom in tamarac and we still continue to drive the distance to continue getting the best care there is for our fur babies.
great service

Sorry but I cannot any longer return to Gopet Animal Hospital.  Today was the final straw.  I went in for a final followup to my Cavaliers ear infection and to get a rabies vaccine.  My previous appointment at 11:30 I waited till 1pm to see a doctor and it wasn't Dr. Gutierrez. Dr. Gutierrez saw my dog a couple weeks ago, treated my dog and said I want to see you in two weeks.  I made an appointment and yet today no Doctor Gutierrez but a stand in Doc that didn't even know I was there.  He looked in my dogs ears and said yes, they look clean.  Then they presented me with their usual "estimate" of what they wanted to do today, ear swab, labs, several vaccines for $271.  Huh.  I just came in for a followup and a rabies.  I left the dog, went to Publix to shop and came back to pick him up.  Nothing had been done.  We cannot rabies him as we have no proof he's been neutered.  Huh, again, I got up to the desk and again they presented me a estimate for $271.  I told them I had already told the examining room I wanted nothing but the shot and an office call.  The lady at the front desk was dissmisive and rude.  There seems to be a total disconnect between the front desk and the back.  I just said let me pay for an office call, period.  $57 I paid and left, never to return and no more recommendations to my fellow pet owners at Quayside.

We cannot thank Dr. Eric Gutierrez and the entire staff enough for the compassion, dedication, and care they showed our beloved cat, Kat Von D. Over the course of several months, they went above and beyond to help her, always taking the time to explain her treatment, answer our questions, and genuinely care about her well-being.

Although we ultimately lost our sweet girl, we know that everything possible was done for her. During one of the most difficult times of our lives, the kindness, honesty, and compassion shown by Dr. Gutierrez and the staff meant more to us than words can express. Their generosity and support after her passing demonstrated just how deeply they care about both their patients and their families.

We will always be grateful for the love and dedication they gave Kat Von D. If you are looking for a veterinarian who truly treats your pets as family, we highly recommend this practice.
Thank you again for your kindness and care.
Excellent place to take your pets for a checkup with Dr. Erik

Very disappointed. I brought a stray cat, pretty ill, in the early morning to see if she could be saved; around 3pm I received a call from the vet saying that his recommendation was to put her asleep; I said “fine, if there’s no other way, I want to be with her, I can be there in 10minutes”
The answer was “no, we can’t wait, we’re closing since there’s no other patients, consider it done!200$ will be charged on the CC on file”. I tried multiple times but they basically proceeded while we were at the phone. Very rude and unprofessional
I left the cat in the morning and they waited all day to let me know that the only solution was to put her asleep and they decided to do so 2 minutes before closing the store at 3pm, without leaving the opportunity to say goodbye.
The entire team is so sweet and welcoming every time we go. My dog loves to come here he has no idea it’s the vet. Super reasonable prices and everyone is super understanding. Highly recommend!

Traumatic is the only way to summarize this experience. I took my dog there before and it was excellent. Not anymore…. Without getting into details here are some highlights:
I waited over an hour even though my appointment was scheduled. Finally a technician came in who did not speak English. However, she did present me with a bill before the doctor even saw my dog. Sometime later, the Dr finally came in. Dr. Brenda.Castillo. Her primary job was to further upsell me on tests and medications my dog clearly didn’t need. Second guessing myself, I agreed to her recommendations. She left and the tech came back to draw blood. Eight pokes later she couldn’t do it. I’ve never experienced anything like this before and neither did my dog. It was now close to two hours that we were at this clinic and I finally had to say STOP. She bandaged him up and came out with another bill. This time she added another medication he didn’t need. Now I put my foot down. She left the room and came back with Different medication. The bill was exorbitant. I paid and ran out of there just to end the nightmare. If you read this review and still take your pet there, please be cautious.

Exceptional Care & Truly Trustworthy

I can’t say enough great things about this veterinary clinic. From the moment I walked in, the staff was welcoming, professional, and genuinely caring. You can immediately tell they truly love what they do and treat every pet like their own.

The doctor took the time to thoroughly examine my dog, explain everything in detail, and answer all my questions without rushing. What really stood out to me was the honesty and transparency—no unnecessary treatments, just what was truly best for my pet.

My dog has had ongoing ear issues, and after visiting multiple places, this is the first time I felt confident in both the diagnosis and the treatment plan. Within days, I saw a real improvement.

The clinic is very clean, well-organized, and runs on time, which I really appreciate. Prices are fair for the level of care and expertise you receive.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable, honest, and compassionate veterinarian, this is the place to go. Highly recommended—I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my pet.
Good service, excellent attention. Healthy and happy Pet and owner

As a rescue, he has been nothing less than magnificent to me personally.  He helps a lot of rescues, but he is also very candid.  He does not sugar coat the fact that an animal may have to be put to sleep because he sees much further than us when it comes the medical status of the animal.  If he thinks there is a chance, he lets us know and gives us the costs.    Rescues do have to keep in mind that this Veterinary Hospital is not a charity, but his discounts to us rescues, at least to me, are wonderful.  I have only good things to say about this veterinary hospital. It is not run like crazy vet clinic that just feels disorganized.  I guess because of his military background, which I do appreciate because my Dad was military and most of my cousins were too, he runs the place like a tight ship and the staff is courteous, friendly, knowledgeable and if they do not know something, they ask us to wait and they will ask Dr. Eric. Thanks to Dr. Eric, I got many cats to their forever homes because he was an asset in guiding me through their journey, and sometimes without even looking at the animal, just from a blood test, or fecal test, he would call me and tell me what to do and instruct me to make a follow up appt once I do what he instructed. He is amazing.  I have only kind words to describe GoPet, and a good experiences with Dr. Gutierrez and his wonderful staff for over five years and thru different rescue groups that I have joined. Thank you so much.  Gina

I have been going to Dr. Gutierrez (Dr. Eric) as we call him, for over 5 or 6 years,.or more... I lost count since he took over Dr. Baks office.  A long time.  Both for my personal animals and as a rescue

He is always kind, extremely knowledgeable and he has so much medical/veterinary information in his brain that he should be teaching Vet schools bc he not only applies his knowledge, he also applies his intuition which in my experience for my own animals has been absolutely precise! However, I need him as my Vet, do I rather he not teach Vet School students - perhaps write a Veterinary Memoi?  That would be really cool

I also love it that he is open to holistic medicine for the animals.  My family is pretty much holistic and we totally appreciate that.  His staff is amazing, hard working and disciplined.  I love.going there and he is just a kind a person.  Humans are just unreasonable sometimes and they expect more than the reality can provide and well, they get mad at the person providing a service instead of stepping back and analyzing at the full picture.

Dr. Eric ia my go to Vet for my pets. God Bless his hands and God Bless his family and entire staff with Goodness all around.  Amen.
What a kind staff! My dog loves Dr. Gutierrez.
Best veterinarian &  Brenda is excellent. Recommend anyone with a Frenchie to go there.

Excellent environment for my dog!!! They are very happy to help out and caring, they truly love what they do ! Dr.  Eric and his staff are  the best. The whole staff is very knowledgeable, professional and friendly, my beautiful baby is comfortable with them. 1 hour trip is totally worth it. 💯 Highly recommend and highly satisfied Best Veterinarian in North Miami and Aventura area.

I recently had a frustrating experience with the front desk staff at GoPet Hospital.

However, once Dr. Gutierrez became aware of the situation, he personally reached out to me. I truly appreciate his time, care, and willingness to find a solution.

He is an excellent, compassionate, and highly knowledgeable doctor. He provides accurate diagnoses, takes the time to explain everything clearly, and genuinely cares about the well-being of the animals he treats. You can truly see his dedication and professionalism in the way he works.

I am making a review of this vet because I feel the need to let people know this is not a vet you should take a severely sick/wounded animal to, they unfortunately do not seem to have the time to do even the baseline exam services.

I brought in a very sick cat that I found while on a walk. I brought him to this vet because I asked the people who lived in the house he was in front of and they said he has no owner but they brought him to this vet once before, so I figured I could get some information about him from his previous visit and that they would understand the situation he is in. Not only did they neglect him in his previous visit, they did this time as well even when I was directly asking for preventative care/a diagnosis/information about him that I could then share with a specialist. The Dr. recommended euthanasia multiple times after spending only 5 minutes with him, which is disgusting considering he was 10x better 24hrs after the visit because I had asked for antibiotics/fluids (I had to ask multiple times). I never received his file, which I also called and asked about multiple times, which has now made it more difficult with his specialist appointment.

Don’t go here, they were happy to charge me $300 while i’m trying to save a cat’s life, and they didn’t care either way if he lived or died.

I used to trust this doctor and take my dog here pretty often to deal with her allergies. Recently my dog has been acting weird, first visit Dr said it was just her allergies and an ear infection and sent her home. Second visit “respiratory infection”, THIRD visit all in the same week with no improvement, gave her x-rays (which I asked for and have not received) said everything is fine. My dog has not shown improvement yet and each day I am more worried, I don’t think I can trust or believe this Dr any further. Since the first visit he hasn’t even had the decency to step out for a second to personally speak to us. Each day it is hard to think his practice is not just for the intent of squeezing money out of his patients just like many other vets in the city.

I cannot say any more good things about this place.  From the moment you are greeted at the front door you notice the professionalism and caring attitude of each of their staff.  Once you reach Dr. Gutierrez, he greets you with a huge smile and intently listens to your concerns.  Years ago I put my beloved dog Rocco down and Dr. Gutierrez was there alongside during such a sad moment.  He is now treating the last of my elder dogs and will soon treat the youngest addition to the family.  I highly recommend this family business.

My 87 year old mother was reduced to tears last week by the hostile and uncaring front desk staff. It was absolutely unacceptable. The front desk staff has always been unhelpful and rude, but this time was the last time. Dr. Gutierrez and his techs are very caring and capable, so we have put up with the nasty front desk. Now it has become impossible and we have switched vets. Too bad the insolent, unprofessional and uncaring front desk staff scares people away.

Dr. Gutierrez is everything you want in a vet, compassion, and honesty.  His staff is professional, caring and thoughtful.   In terms of cost, reasonable, not over the top and offering the alternatives based on issue at hand.  Highly recommend!!!!
Been taking my fur baby here for years. Dr. Eric Gutierrez and his staff are accessible and kind. Compared to two other vets, I find that his prices are reasonable.
